segments.text: also known as Dr Dance Over four decades he studied how dancing helps improve brain function in everyone from children and adults to older people living with diseases like Parkinson and Alzheimer

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Dr Lovett's dance therapy involves spontaneous movements, closing your eyes and letting the music move you.

segments.speaker: Beth

segments.text: comes from Scotland. OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with

segments.text: boogie strut your stuff, throw shapes and hit the dance floor. All modern idioms meaning to dance.

segments.text: If you do something like nobody's business, you do it very well or very quickly.
